title: Fictional tie-rod study
objective: Minimize mass at fixed length and tensile force.
derivation: Assume uniform axial tension and a common safety factor n. From m = density * A * L and A >= n * F / yield_strength, minimum mass scales with density / yield_strength. Maximize the reciprocal.
